releases.name: Nocturnal 2
releases.summary: Nocturnal 2 is an atmospheric action adventure game in which you play as Ardeshir, bearer of the Enduring Flame, who sets out to explore the dark depths and towering heights of the forgotten city of Ytash in order to break the curse that has consumed his homeland.

releases.name: Hidden Bananas
releases.summary: Find hidden bananas across tropical islands! Relaxing point-and-click gameplay with beautiful ocean views and soothing music. Can you spot them all?

releases.name: The Fixer
releases.summary: Football star on Saturday, match fixer the rest of the week. Rig games for the syndicate, launder dirty money and keep your suspicion gauge under control in this narrative career sim. How far will you go before it all comes crashing down?

releases.name: Combo Break
releases.summary: Combo Break fuses the hypnotic pull of a peg-bouncer with roguelite deckbuilding. Load your board with special pegs, chain their effects into screen-filling combos, and watch the payouts explode. One more ball. One bigger combo. One perfect board.

releases.name: Clogwork
releases.summary: CLOGWORK is a factory-automation game where you turn random pieces into final shapes. Build conveyor belts, glue, cut and rotate parts, wire logic signals, and send the finished shape to the hub to fulfil ever-changing orders.

releases.name: Neon Horde

releases.name: Powder Park
releases.summary: Build a snowy winter resort and do whatever it takes to keep your guests happy. Sculpt every slope, place every building, then strap on your snowboard and ride your own runs. Powder Park is a new experience from one of the creators of the original Ski Resort Tycoon.

releases.name: One Lucky AA
releases.summary: ONLY LUCK !!! In this adventure, every step is a bet. Navigate through perilous trials where strategy meets pure chance. Master unique luck-management mechanics to survive when the odds are zero.

releases.name: Combustor
releases.summary: Gas reaction simulator. Build the ultimate jet engine, solve puzzles, or just make everything explode!

releases.name: Alpha 7: The Last Hope
releases.summary: Alpha 7: The Last Hope: A frantic one-button bullet hell style space cyberpunk. Survive with Dave across 6 stages, master 12 ships, unlock the Lore, and enjoy the original jukebox. An extreme, fully inclusive challenge.

releases.name: BRAINFREEZE
releases.summary: FOR ALL GANGNAM STYLE LOVERS!*****Addictive*****Simple*****Fun*****Gangnam Style Racing is an addicting and challenging game that follows PSY on a race to a show. He needs your help to get there on time dodging other racers and even a crazy horse! This is a universal game that works on iPhone, iPad, and iPod Touch

releases.name: After All Is Abraded: A Study on Disappearing Completely
Clay Crusade: Night of the Necromancer
releases.summary: Hack N' Slash zombie survival horror game featuring a claymation art style set in fantasy world. Upgrade your arsenal and fight through hordes of zombies to stop the evil necromancer and return peace to the kingdom!

releases.name: FISH OS
releases.summary: An idle fishing game built inside a fake 1997 operating system. Catch 250 species, upgrade your gear, send boats out overnight, and prestige when the numbers get too big. Comes with Solitaire, a paint program, and seagulls.

releases.name: Pray Your God!
releases.summary: You will choose a number. I will choose one too. Should your god make them agree, heaven removes me in ways I would rather not describe. Should it not, and it will not, you lose a follower. Found your cult. The paperwork is ready.

releases.name: A Quiet Place Between Us
releases.summary:
A beautiful romance visual novel where love blossoms gently before drifting toward heartbreak. 

Guide Hina and Kenta through a warm yet fragile relationship shaped by outside pressure, hidden motives, and painful choices leading to emotional multiple endings.

releases.name: Hexograph
releases.summary: Hexograph is a hexagonal twist on nonogram puzzles. Use logic to solve handcrafted multi-color grids, read clues across three directions, untangle special hint rules, and reveal colorful hidden pictures.

releases.name: Abyssal Elevator: Idle Breaker
releases.summary: An addictive idle brick-breaker meets Bullet Heaven. Descend a dark abyss, buy heaps of bouncy orbs, and watch them smash hordes of skeletons to dust. No manual aiming, no reloading—just absolute physics chaos and satisfying chain reactions!

releases.name: Gobs & Gears
releases.summary: Reconstruct a Gob factory lost in the Fog. Route resources, put the Gobs to work, and build the BIG BOOM. The Gob King wants his bomb and he wants it NOW!

releases.name: Echoes of Absence
releases.summary: A narrative psychological horror game where you'll explore different environments and fragments of your past. Solve puzzles and uncover a truth some would rather forget.

releases.name: Homemaking: Build & Decorate
releases.summary: Build a home from the first wall to the last cushion. Draw rooms on a one-metre grid, cut in doors and windows, paper the walls, then furnish them from 1,284 pieces. No timers, no budget, no wrong answers - just you, a house, and the light moving across the floor.

releases.name: Soundway
releases.summary: Ride your own music. Soundway transforms any song into a neon roller coaster racing through deep space, with every burst of speed, climb, drop, and turn shaped by the track itself. Catch the beat, build massive combos, dodge hazards, and chase the music across the stars.

releases.name: Rebirth TD
releases.summary: Defend a dying world and bring it back to life. Grow spirit trees, push back a world-consuming blight, and restore the forest as you play through atmospheric levels.

releases.name: Tai Chi Tarot
releases.summary: In the game world You control a super metal ball As needed Looking for super property licensing Changed to Four kinds of attributes form Break down barriers The triumph Very simple Come and try.

releases.name: EEL KNOW:Perfect Pitch
releases.summary: A garden eel's length is your clue to the pitch! Guess sounds on the keyboard to train your absolute pitch. Correct answers add eels with unique sounds to your encyclopedia. Create custom quizzes, unlock new instrument tones, and send them to friends to sharpen your ears together!

releases.name: Path Defenders: RPG Siege Defense
releases.summary: Path Defenders is a 3D action tower defense RPG. Build a strategy party and jump into real-time combat to fight alongside your summoned heroes against epic bosses, all driven by a lofi and vaporwave soundtrack.

releases.name: Never Sort By Color
releases.summary: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile in first person with magnet gloves, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.

releases.name: Turnabout Tactics
releases.summary: Control both sides of the board in this chess puzzle game. Use real chess movement, bombs, shields, freezing auras, crumbling tiles, and more to solve combinations of objectives.

releases.name: The Sea is Our Stage
releases.summary: A fantasy yuri visual novel in which a noblewoman uncovers her father's evil plot and, along with her lowborn friends, takes to the seas to flee from high society. Her plan to right her family's wrongs and return home are disrupted by the untimely arrival of an enigmatic and flirtatious pirate.

releases.name: GUGUGAGA: PEEKABOO
releases.summary: GUGUGAGA! Sudoku! Minesweeper! Combined gameplay!! Plus, you can play online with friends!!!

releases.name: Speed King
releases.summary: Race as anything from pigs to firetrucks in a chaotic 3D racer where every competitor has unique abilities and every track brings unexpected challenges.

releases.name: Edge of the Blade
releases.summary: Edge of the Blade is a roguelite grand-strategy autobattler where you choose one of three factions and fight over the ruined land of Cheonggu. Set weekly war objectives, capture strongholds, deploy your army, and shape the flow of battle through your choices.
